Description: Reflection Pond, marked by this small sign, is a few miles north of Wonder Lake Campground. Visitors can reach Reflection Pond via either a Kantishna-bound bus, or by getting off a Wonder Lake-bound bus at the "Y," which is an intersection between the main Denali Park Road and the Wonder Lake Campground spur road. From the "Y," Reflection Pond is about a quarter-mile away, to the north.
